Appraiser remarks
The vehicle shows a crushed and creased left front fender, a cracked headlamp assembly, and a bent front bumper
bracket on the driver side. The impact pattern is consistent with a vehicle turning left into the path of another car.
Some of the lower bumper scuffing and the inner wheel well damage may not be clearly tied to this event, so those
items need closer inspection before final approval. The repair plan calls for replacing the fender and headlamp,
straightening the bracket, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested are a little high for this scope
of work and should be reviewed against standard repair times. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and the
shop invoices show no repeated charges.
